mapper.select: SELECT M.SQL_SEQ, M.CPNY_ID, M.PGM_NM, M.SQL_NM, M.SQL_FROM_STMT, M.SQL_ORDER_BY_ID, M.SQL_DESC, NVL(M.SQL_STAT, 'N') AS SQL_STAT, NVL(M.IS_SPECIAL, 'N') AS IS_SPECIAL, M.SQL_STMT, TO_CHAR(M.RGST_DTIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS RGST_DTIME, TO_CHAR(M.UPDT_DTIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS UPDT_DTIME, M.UPDT_USER FROM SYS_SQL_MASTER M WHERE M.SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_SQL_MASTER (SQL_SEQ, CPNY_ID, PGM_NM, SQL_NM, SQL_STMT, SQL_FROM_STMT, SQL_ORDER_BY_ID, SQL_DESC, SQL_STAT, RGST_DTIME, UPDT_DTIME, UPDT_USER, USE_YN, IS_SPECIAL) VALUES (#{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pgmNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sqlNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sqlStmt, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{sqlFromStmt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sqlOrderById, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sqlDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{sqlStat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE, SUBSTR(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 10), 'Y', NVL(#{isSpecial, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'))
mapper.update: UPDATE SYS_SQL_MASTER M SET M.PGM_NM = #{pgmNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, M.SQL_NM = #{sqlNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, M.SQL_STMT = #{sqlStmt, jdbcType=CLOB}, M.SQL_FROM_STMT = #{sqlFromStmt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, M.SQL_ORDER_BY_ID = #{sqlOrderById, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, M.SQL_DESC = #{sqlDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, M.SQL_STAT = NVL(#{sqlStat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), M.IS_SPECIAL = NVL(#{isSpecial, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), M.UPDT_USER = SUBSTR(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 10), M.UPDT_DTIME = SYSDATE WHERE M.SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_PARAM_BY_SQL (SQL_SEQ, SQL_PARAM_NO, PARAM, EN_SQL_PARAM_DESC, CN_SQL_PARAM_DESC, SQL_PARAM_TP, SORT_CD, RGST_DTIME, USE_YN) SELECT #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(NVL((SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SQL_PARAM_NO)) + 1 FROM SYS_PARAM_BY_SQL WHERE SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 0)), #{param, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enSqlParamDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cnSqlParamDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sqlParamTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 'Y' FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE SYS_PARAM_BY_SQL SET EN_SQL_PARAM_DESC = #{enSqlParamDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CN_SQL_PARAM_DESC = #{cnSqlParamDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SQL_PARAM_TP = #{sqlParamTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SORT_CD = #{sortCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDT_DTIME = SYSDATE, UPDT_USER = SUBSTR(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 10) WHERE SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PARAM = #{param, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYS_PARAM_BY_SQL WHERE SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
